title: Cloud Computing
tagline: Build practical cloud capability across Azure and AWS.
sectionDescription: Cloud training that moves from fundamentals to administration, networking, security, and architecture in real enterprise environments.
overview: Industry-relevant cloud training for teams and professionals building secure, scalable cloud platforms.

title: VMware & Virtualization
tagline: Design, operate, and govern production virtualisation platforms.
sectionDescription: Hands-on VMware and virtualisation training covering the platform decisions that keep enterprise workloads available and predictable.
overview: A practical route through cluster design, lifecycle operations, workload resilience, and virtualisation architecture.

title: Windows Server
tagline: Operate secure, resilient Microsoft server environments.
sectionDescription: Windows Server programmes that connect administration fundamentals with identity, networking, security, and enterprise operations.
overview: Build the operational confidence to manage Windows infrastructure and solve the issues that surface in production.

title: Linux Administration
tagline: Build dependable Linux skills for modern infrastructure teams.
sectionDescription: Practical Linux administration covering command-line fluency, services, security, automation, and production troubleshooting.
overview: Learn to administer, secure, automate, and troubleshoot Linux systems with confidence.
prerequisites: A willingness to work from the command line

title: Networking
tagline: Design, operate, and troubleshoot resilient enterprise networks.
sectionDescription: Networking pathways from foundational connectivity through professional routing, switching, wireless, security, and Juniper technologies.
overview: A field-led route through enterprise networking and operational discipline, built around realistic topology decisions rather than memorized commands.

title: Programming & Development
tagline: Turn problem-solving into useful software capability.
sectionDescription: Programming programmes designed for IT professionals who need practical Python, automation, scripting, and development foundations.
overview: Build programming fluency that supports infrastructure automation, data work, and application development.

title: Database Technologies
tagline: Build, secure, and operate reliable data platforms.
sectionDescription: Database training across Oracle, SQL Server, and PostgreSQL, with a practical emphasis on administration, performance, availability, and security.
overview: Develop the skills to administer and support the databases that enterprise applications depend on.

title: AI & Emerging Technologies
tagline: Prepare teams for the next generation of technical work.
sectionDescription: Future-facing programmes that connect AI concepts and emerging technologies to responsible, practical use in modern organizations.
overview: Explore the technologies reshaping engineering work while keeping the focus on useful, responsible implementation.

title: Customized Training
tagline: Build a curriculum around your people, platform, and priorities.
sectionDescription: Bespoke training for organizations that need a specific technology stack, delivery model, or architecture challenge addressed.
overview: A tailored programme combining the technologies, lab environments, and delivery format your organization needs.
